# Larger Comparable-Block OOS Results

Fixed-parameter paired evaluation of Design A and Design C.

## Method

The study uses 250 observed rows of expanding initial history and 80-row OOS blocks. Eight equal-sized blocks are usable; the deterministic terminal remainder is not promoted to a shorter block. Each block resets to THB 10,000,000. Features are built only after truncating approved rows at that block's OOS end.

## Statistical status

The pre-registered statistical test was not run. More blocks improve descriptive coverage but do not make expanding-window blocks independent. The results require human approval before any inferential test.
